The Board

The Memphis-Shelby County Schools Board of Education sets policy for the district and oversees its business. T. L. Harris holds the District 6 seat, one of nine.

  • 9Elected commissioners, one from each district in Shelby County
  • TogetherThe board governs as a body. No single commissioner acts alone.
  • MonthlyBusiness meetings on the last Tuesday at 5:30 p.m., with a work session the week before
  • PublicOpen to residents, streamed live, on Cable Channel 19 and Radio 88.5 FM

Source: Memphis-Shelby County Schools Board of Education. Accessed 24 September 2026.

The board's job

The board governs the business operations of Memphis-Shelby County Schools. Its stated mission is to prepare all students for success in learning, leadership and life.

Looking for the schools in District 6? They are listed on the District 6 page.

Public meetings

All regular Business Meetings of the Shelby County Board of Education are held at the Frances E. Coe Administration Building, 160 S. Hollywood Street, at 5:30 p.m. on the final Tuesday of each month. The Board holds Work Sessions on Tuesdays one week before all regular business meetings.

This describes how the Board operates as a body. The district's own calendar is the authoritative schedule.

Agendas and meeting documents

MSCS publishes Board agendas and meeting documents through BoardDocs.

Open BoardDocs

Public comment

Public comment is offered at regular Business Meetings and Special Called Meetings, and is not permitted at Board Work Sessions or Board Committee Meetings. The sign-up sheet is offered 30 minutes before the meeting and is closed at the start of it.
